name: Flow Traders Ltd.
quirks: Revenue column is Net Trading Income (NTI); Total Income (NTI + other income) is kpis.TotalIncome, so NetMargin is net profit / NTI. OCF and FCF are trading-capital working-capital swings, not cash generation -- valued on earnings at cost of equity, never subtract net debt (trading capital is required capital). No VaR or regulatory-capital metric is disclosed in a usable series.
